payload.rebuttal: fixed: The test checked the resulting text and the defects left, but never the `rewrites` list's own order, so a function that produced the same final text through a differently-ordered `rewrites` list would still pass. I added an explicit assertion comparing `[(r.path, r.old, r.new) for r in rewrites]` against the expected text-order sequence. Confirmed the mutation (sorting `rewrites` in reverse order) now fails the test, then reverted it.
